sources.title: Mamba (deep learning architecture) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Mamba is a deep learning architecture focused on sequence modeling. It was developed by two researchers Albert Gu from Carnegie Mellon University and Tri Dao from Princeton University to address some limitations of transformer models, especially in processing long sequences, and it is based on the Structured State Space sequence (S4) model. sources.title: What is a Mamba model - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: Mamba is a neural network architecture designed for large language models and long-sequence tasks. It overcomes Transformer limitations by providing faster inference, lower memory usage and better scalability all without using attention. sources.title: GitHub - xtt-lzt/LS-Mamba
sources.snippet: Official PyTorch implementation of LS-Mamba: Gated Spatio-Temporal Modulation and Bidirectional State Space Modeling for EEG Emotion Recognition. LS-Mamba is a lightweight hybrid architecture for EEG-based emotion recognition. It combines a Large-Small Gating mechanism for hierarchical spatio-temporal modulation and a bidirectional Mamba encoder for efficient long-range temporal modeling.
